The aorist indicates a decisive moment when they realized they couldn't handle the abundance alone. Classical usage shows the word for nodding assent, beckoning, or making any head/hand signal. The cross-linguistic glosses emphasize non-verbal communication. The single biblical occurrence captures the wordless urgency of fishermen overwhelmed by the haul—gesture suffices when immediate help is needed."
